projects.title: E-Commerce Dashboard
projects.shortDescription: A comprehensive dashboard for managing e-commerce sales, inventory, and customer data with real-time analytics.
projects.longDescription: A fully-featured e-commerce management dashboard built with React and Redux. It offers real-time sales analytics, inventory management, customer data tracking, and reporting tools. Designed for scalability and ease of use.
projects.challenges: Handling large amounts of real-time data efficiently while maintaining a smooth UI.
projects.solutions: Used Redux for predictable state management and Chart.js for optimized data visualization.

projects.title: Social Media Connect
projects.shortDescription: A full-stack social media application allowing users to share posts, connect with friends, and chat in real-time.
projects.longDescription: A full-stack social media platform featuring real-time chat using Socket.io, post sharing, friend connections, and a modern feed UI. Built with a Node.js/Express backend and MongoDB for data persistence.
projects.challenges: Implementing real-time features and managing concurrent WebSocket connections.
projects.solutions: Used Socket.io with rooms and namespaces to efficiently handle real-time events.

projects.title: Fitness Tracker App
projects.shortDescription: A cross-platform mobile application to track daily workouts, diet, and progress towards fitness goals.
projects.longDescription: A cross-platform mobile fitness application developed with Flutter and Dart, using Firebase for authentication and real-time data sync. Features workout logging, dietary tracking, progress charts, and goal setting.
projects.challenges: Synchronizing offline SQLite data with Firebase when connectivity is restored.
projects.solutions: Implemented a sync queue that batches offline changes and replays them on reconnection.

projects.title: Task Management System
projects.shortDescription: A project management tool with Kanban boards, team collaboration features, and automated notifications.
projects.longDescription: A powerful project management tool featuring Kanban-style boards, real-time team collaboration, task assignment, progress tracking, and automated email notifications. Built with React and TypeScript on the frontend and Firebase as a backend.
projects.challenges: Managing complex drag-and-drop interactions across multiple Kanban columns.
projects.solutions: Used react-beautiful-dnd with a normalized Redux state structure for predictable updates.
